name: Renata The Warrior
source:
When the construction worker of a death tournament finds out her wife entered, she must do everything she can to keep her alive.

[From [url=https://vibing-eagle.itch.io/renata-the-warrior]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一名负责建造死亡锦标赛场地的建筑女工得知自己的妻子竟然报名参赛时，她必须不惜一切代价让妻子活着走下赛场。

[摘自[url=https://vibing-eagle.itch.io/renata-the-warrior]Itch.io[/url]]
